title: fix(spec): title the view.columns, view.tabs and view.sort repeater row properties
body:
Fixes #17507

Clause-②: no

## What this does

Studio renders a `type: 'repeater'` form field as a table. Its column headers read `items.properties[k].title ?? k` off the JSON Schema derived from the metadata type schema. None of the 25 row properties of the three view repeaters carried a `title`, so the maker saw raw keys (`field`, `width`, `isDefault`, `order`) in every locale, English included. Each row property now carries a short English `.meta({ title })`, in the convention the already-paid carriers use (`.describe(...)` then `.meta({ title: 'Title Case' })`).

Three regions of `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` change, and nothing else in that file:

| carrier | schema | row properties | titles |
|---|---|---|---|
| `view.columns` | `ListColumnSchema` | 14 | Field, Label, Width (px), Alignment, Hidden, Sortable, Resizable, Wrap Text, Renderer Type, Pinned, Summary, Prefix, Primary Link, Click Action |
| `view.tabs` | `ViewTabSchema` | 9 | Name, Label, Icon, List View, Filter, Display Order, Pinned, Default Tab, Visible |
| `view.sort` | the list arm's INLINE `{ field, order }` entry | 2 | Field, Direction (the same titles as the shared `SortItemSchema`) |

The repeater-title ledger (`packages/spec/src/kernel/repeater-item-titles.test.ts`) loses its last three entries (`view:columns`, `view:sort`, `view:tabs`) and is now EMPTY. Every repeater a form declares is fully titled, so a new untitled one fails its own PR. The ledger's header comment now says so.

`ViewTabSchema` is also reused outside `view.tabs` (for example `json-schema/ui/InterfacePageConfig.json` now carries `"Default Tab"`), so those uses get the same titles. That is expected: it is one schema.

## Measured first, on the base

Base: `44ce049a8c`, which was `origin/main` when the worktree was cut. I re-derived the counts through the ledger's own predicate: `z.toJSONSchema(getMetadataTypeSchema('view'), { unrepresentable: 'any', io: 'input' })`, with union arms kept as separate candidates and the property node read before its `$ref` target. The derivation helpers were copied from the ledger file into a scratch script. No source regex was used.

| carrier | authorable | untitled before | untitled after |
|---|---|---|---|
| view:columns | 14 | 14 | 0 |
| view:tabs | 9 | 9 | 0 |
| view:sort | 2 | 2 | 0 |

These are the same 14 / 9 / 2 as the card's 2026-09-10 reading. I re-ran the derivation with `io: 'output'`, which is what `/meta/types` serves. It also reads 0 / 0 / 0 untitled after the change.

- **What "title" means here.** The ledger reads `raw?.title ?? prop?.title`: the property node first, then its `$ref` target. That is the JSON Schema `title`, which zod emits from `.meta({ title })`. `.describe()` feeds `description` only.
- **What the ledger records.** It records membership only (a `Set` of carrier ids), not a count. A carrier in the set must have a non-empty `untitled` list. A carrier outside the set must have an empty `untitled` list. So "shrink" here means deleting the three ids.

## Both traps, handled

1. **The union arm.** `columns` is an object array on the list arm and an INTEGER on the form arm. The ledger keeps every union arm as a separate candidate and prefers the object-item array arm. The list arm's `z.union([z.array(z.string()), z.array(ListColumnSchema)])` resolves to the `ListColumnSchema` rows. Nothing here merges arms.
2. **The inline sort entry.** `view.sort` is titled on the INLINE entry itself. The shared `SortItemSchema` was titled earlier and never reached this entry.

## Firing control

The fix was committed first. I then mutated it and restored it through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`:

- **Mutation:** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts --anchor ".meta({ title: 'Display Order' })" --delete -- pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 src/kernel/repeater-item-titles.test.ts`
  - on disk: anchor count 1 to 0, blob `b4451833e711` to `a014831e9ce2`.
  - **RED:** `view:tabs: these row properties have no .meta({ title }) ... expected [ 'order' ] to deeply equal []`. Tests: 1 failed, 25 passed (26).
  - restored: blob equals HEAD (`b4451833e711`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Green leg:** the same test file on the restored tree at `7a30204ebf`. Tests: 26 passed (26).
- **An earlier attempt was a no-op.** It used `--replacement` with text that is a substring of the anchor. The tool refused it before the command ran (the replacement count rose by 0) and restored the file. It produced no reading.

## Downstream readers: the generators

| generator | result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` (runs `gen:schema` and `gen:openapi`) | no tracked file moved. The gitignored but published `json-schema/ui/ListColumn.json` now carries the titles (`"title": "Field"`, `"title": "Width (px)"` and the rest). |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` | all 15 artifacts up to date: `authorable-surface/` (keys, not titles), `api-surface/` and `content/docs/references/**` are byte-identical |
| `pnpm i18n:extract` | 11 files written, zero diff |
| `pnpm check:i18n` (all nine bundle packages) | in sync |

No generated file moved. The titles do not reach the metadata-form bundles, because `viewForm` enumerates no row children for these three repeaters and `os i18n extract` keys off declared children. See Acceptance notes.

## Changeset

`.changeset/17507-view-repeater-row-titles.md` is `@objectstack/spec: patch`. My reading:

- **Published bytes move, so `skip-changeset` is wrong.** `@objectstack/spec` publishes `dist`, `json-schema` and `src/**/*.zod.ts` (its `files[]`). After the build, `dist/ui/index.mjs` carries `Renderer Type` (1 hit; 0 hits in `src` at the base; a nonsense string reads 0).
- **Nothing an author can write moves.** No key or value is added, removed or narrowed, and `authorable-surface/` is byte-identical. So `Clause-②: no`, and a released-package fix takes `patch` (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3).
- **The precedent is split.** `#17506`'s PR read the same shape as `patch` with `Clause-②: no`. `#17505`'s PR took `yes` / `minor` for the same shape. This PR follows the claim and the newer reading.

## Verification

All runs are at `7a30204ebf` unless stated. Heavy runs went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, on a shared box.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: green, at `69da9fed7e` (the fix commit, where `check:generated` also ran; the only later commit adds the changeset file) and again at `7a30204ebf`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`: 526 files, 15501 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project repo --maxWorkers=2`: 35 files, 602 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: green (tsc, the scripts program and the test layer).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run --passWithNoTests --maxWorkers=2`: 54 files, 883 passed. This includes `repeater-row-properties.test.ts`, whose dark control ("view enumerates no repeater row properties yet") still holds.
- **Consumers of the served titles** (the wire shape gains `title` nodes):
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts` and `protocol.meta-types-unauthorable-columns.test.ts`: 26 passed.
  - `@objectstack/rest` `meta-types-schema-titles.test.ts`: 3 passed.
  - Declared narrowing: the rest of those two packages' suites are left to CI.
- **Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` was re-derived after the changeset landed: 82 families, all run. The `--ran` reconciliation reads "82 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 82 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
  - Two gates first exited 3 and were re-run green after a rebuild. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` was missing some workspace dists. `check:type-check-debt` saw stale spec and platform-objects entry points, caused by this run's own ablation and extract.
- **ESLint, narrowed and proven.** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the two changed `.ts` files: 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
  - Population: both files resolve a config under `--print-config` (neither is ignored), and `pnpm lint` is `eslint .`.
  - Invariance: the resolved `parserOptions` are `{ ecmaVersion: 'latest', sourceType: 'module' }`, with no `project` or `projectService`. Linting is therefore not type-aware, so this diff cannot change a verdict on any untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- **The branch is behind `origin/main`, without overlap.** `origin/main` has moved 4 commits past the base. None of them touches these three paths or any `packages/spec` generated artifact; the one `packages/spec` change upstream is in `src/contracts/`. I did not merge main in; CI's merge ref validates the joint tree.
- **The titles are English in every locale for now.** `viewForm` declares no row children for `columns`, `sort` or `tabs`, so `os i18n extract` emits no catalog key for them and `resolveMetadataFormSchemaTitles` has nothing to overlay. The row-property localisation pin (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/repeater-row-properties.test.ts`) scopes `view` out explicitly. The follow-on is to enumerate these children in `view.form.ts` with translated leaves. That is outside this card's file surface.
- `#17232` (the parent family) remains open.
